query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saleItems WHERE productId = p.id) as qtd_vendas,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchaseOrderItems WHERE productId = p.id) as qtd_compras
FROM products p
WHERE p.id IN (5280001, 5280002, 5310001, 5310002, 5310003, 4950001, 4950002, 4950003, 4950004, 2070009);
